summary: Defines semantics for the Session Description Protocol that tie a Forward Error Correction stream to the media streams it protects, using the media line grouping mechanism of RFC 3388. It was replaced by RFC 5956.

eli5.summary: Sometimes a video sends extra repair data in case pieces get lost. This note says how to label which repair stream goes with which video stream. It was later replaced.

questions: how to group fec streams in sdp
